*** Add File: /mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/mhd_llm/codex/solver/cuda/validate_hlld.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""HLLD CPU/CUDA64 implementation and CUDA32 precision controls."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import subprocess
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+ROOT = HERE.parents[1]
+OUT = HERE / "validation"
+CPU = HERE / "hlld_cpu/mhd_solver_hlld"
+EXE = {"cpu": CPU, "fp64": HERE / "mhd_cuda_hlld_reference", "fp32": HERE / "mhd_cuda_fp32_async_hlld"}
+
+
+def read(path):return dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)
+
+
+def config(name, backend, values):
+    values = dict(values)
+    values.update(threads=1, flux_variant="split_hlld", output_dir=OUT / f"hlld_{name}_{backend}")
+    path = OUT / f"hlld_{name}_{backend}.cfg"
+    path.write_text("".join(f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in values.items()))
+    return path, Path(values["output_dir"])
+
+
+def compare(name, folders):
+    base = folders["cpu"]
+    a = np.load(sorted(base.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
+    stats = json.loads((base / "statistics.json").read_text())
+    result = {"cpu_statistics": stats, "cpu_hlld_counts": json.loads((base / "hlld_fallbacks.json").read_text())}
+    for backend in folders.keys()-{"cpu"}:
+        alternate = folders[backend]
+        b = np.load(sorted(alternate.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
+        other_stats = json.loads((alternate / "statistics.json").read_text())
+        record = {"statistics": other_stats,
+                  "field_normalized_Linf": (np.max(abs(b-a), axis=(0, 1, 2))/(np.max(abs(a), axis=(0, 1, 2))+1e-30)).tolist(),
+                  "HLLD_counts": json.loads((alternate / "hlld_fallbacks.json").read_text())}
+        if backend == "fp64":
+            record["snapshot_arrays_identical"] = bool(np.array_equal(a, b))
+            if (base / "probe.csv").exists():record["probe_bytes_identical"] = (base / "probe.csv").read_bytes() == (alternate / "probe.csv").read_bytes()
+            record["day_histogram_identical"] = (base / "step_histogram.csv").read_bytes() == (alternate / "step_histogram.csv").read_bytes()
+            record["HLLD_counts_identical"] = result["cpu_hlld_counts"] == record["HLLD_counts"]
+            keys = ["steps", "rejected_steps", "first_order_fallback_steps", "minimum_dt_day", "mean_dimensionless_divB", "max_dimensionless_divB", "weighted_dimensionless_divB"]
+            record["retry_dt_divergence_statistics_identical"] = all(stats[key] == other_stats[key] for key in keys)
+            assert all(record[key] for key in record if key.endswith("identical")), record
+        elif name == "production_coarse":
+            dest = OUT / "hlld_precision_coarse_GTI.json"
+            subprocess.run(["python", str(HERE.parent / "experiments/compare_variant.py"), str(base), str(alternate), str(dest)], check=True)
+            comparison = json.loads(dest.read_text())["GTI_comparisons"]["PN_only"]["probes"]["comet"]
+            record["PN_comet_precision"] = comparison
+            for field in ["n_cm3", "speed_kms", "incident_flux_cm2_s"]:
+                assert comparison[field]["maximum_abs_relative_change_within_observation_span"] < .01, comparison
+        else:assert max(record["field_normalized_Linf"]) < .002, record
+        result[backend] = record
+    (OUT / f"hlld_{name}_agreement.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n")
+    print(name, json.dumps(result), flush=True)
+    return result
+
+
+def main():
+    coarse = read(ROOT / "results/coarse/run.cfg")
+    coarse.update(outer_magnetic_radial_scaling=1, snapshot_days=99, output_start_day=99)
+    path, cpu_folder = config("production_coarse", "cpu", coarse)
+    log = (OUT / "hlld_production_coarse_cpu.log").open("w")
+    proc = subprocess.Popen([str(CPU), "--config", str(path)], stdout=log, stderr=log)
+    results = {}
+    try:
+        cases = {"uniform": (read(OUT / "uniform_gpu.cfg"), ["cpu", "fp64", "fp32"]),
+                 "inductive": (read(OUT / "inductive_global_gpu.cfg"), ["cpu", "fp64", "fp32"]),
+                 "inductive_cones": (read(OUT / "cme_tiny_fp32.cfg"), ["cpu", "fp32"])}
+        for name, (values, backends) in cases.items():
+            folders = {}
+            for backend in backends:
+                path, folders[backend] = config(name, backend, values)
+                subprocess.run([str(EXE[backend]), "--config", str(path)], check=True, timeout=120)
+            results[name] = compare(name, folders)
+        if proc.wait(timeout=300):raise RuntimeError("HLLD CPU control failed; inspect its log")
+        folders = {"cpu": cpu_folder}
+        for backend in ["fp64", "fp32"]:
+            path, folders[backend] = config("production_coarse", backend, coarse)
+            subprocess.run([str(EXE[backend]), "--config", str(path)], check=True, timeout=300)
+        results["production_coarse"] = compare("production_coarse", folders)
+        (OUT / "hlld_agreement_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2)+"\n")
+    finally:
+        if proc.poll() is None:proc.terminate();proc.wait()
+        log.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":main()
*** End Patch"));
